Info.updatesBody: Reviewed support changes will appear here when real data is connected in feature 003. This preview does not invent a change history.
Info.submitBody: App suggestions and correction requests will open in feature 005. No information is submitted or stored in this local preview.
Info.methodologyBody: We distinguish official support, planned support, insufficient evidence, and an explicit statement of non-support. Ordinary iPhone compatibility or an iPad layout alone does not establish Duo optimization.
Info.evidenceBody: App Store release notes, developer documentation, and Apple announcements are reviewed in context: region, version and availability. A search snippet is not evidence.
Info.reviewBody: Collection creates candidates. It does not publish a verdict. Missing information is not proof of non-support, and a failed fetch does not erase previous evidence.
Info.independentBody: Is Duo Ready? is an independent directory, not an Apple service. Display language does not change the store region: this first version targets South Korea.

Import.title: Import apps
Import.description: Import South Korea App Store metadata as drafts. Support assessments and evidence require an administrator’s review and publication.
Import.urlInput: South Korea App Store URLs (one per line)
Import.urlHelp: Enter up to 200 South Korea App Store URLs.
Import.csvHelp: UTF-8 CSV, up to 512 KiB and 200 rows. Required column: app_store_url. Optional: source_url, proposed_status, evidence_summary, announced_at, support_version. A selected file replaces the pasted content.
Import.runningHelp: Processing with a delay between store requests. Stopping finishes the current row and preserves results.
Import.resumeHelp: Check input errors before starting. You can resume an interrupted import.
Import.missingEvidence: Evidence is incomplete. Review official sources and their contents before publication.
Import.proposalHelp: These proposals are unverified. Check the original source before adding them to the evidence fields above.

Operations.collectionHelp: Check registered official sources in small batches. Observations remain private until a person reviews and approves the saved draft. The default interval is one day. Periodic checks require a running collection worker.
Operations.approvalNote: Official source and usage policy check
Operations.targetConfirm: I verified that this is an official source and its terms permit this monitoring. Web sources also require a successful robots check.
Operations.needApp: Create or import an app first.
Operations.limits: Up to 200 registered sources and 30 recent runs are shown. Each click checks one source.
Operations.longFailure: Repeated failures — inspect the source and its access policy.
Operations.weeklyResearch: Weekly editorial task: investigate new apps and official announcements, then register verified sources or review submissions.
Operations.submissionHelp: Visitor reports are private suggestions. Verify official evidence before approving any public change.
Operations.reviewHelp: Compare observations and reports with published information. Prepare a saved draft, then approve, defer or reject the candidate.
Operations.noText: No release note or document text was provided.
Operations.truncated: A bounded excerpt is shown. Open the official source to review the full context.
Operations.compareHelp: A collected observation or visitor report is not a verified support claim. Check the source and prepare the saved draft before approving.
Operations.notPublished: This app has no current public entry.
Operations.draftHelp: Save changes in the editor, then return and reload this review before approving. Candidate text is never copied into evidence automatically.
Operations.importFirst: Import or create the app with this App Store ID first, then reload this review to link it.
Operations.reason: Decision reason (public change reason when approved)
Operations.approveConfirm: For approval: I checked the official evidence and the saved draft shown above, and confirm publication.

Submission.title: Suggest an app or correction
Submission.intro: Send an app suggestion or a correction with a source. Reports remain private and are reviewed before any public change.
Submission.privacy: Do not include contact details or other personal information. We do not ask for an email address. A temporary browser cookie limits repeated submissions.
Submission.receivedBody: Thank you. An administrator will check the source. Sending a report does not change public support information.
